Alpha Mechanical Group Pty Ltd - a mechanical engineering company providing high-quality engineering solutions and services across a range of industrial projects, with a commitment to innovative, efficient and reliable outcomes while maintaining high standards of quality, safety and technical excellence.

As an Engineering Technologist at Alpha Mechanical Group Pty Ltd, you will be responsible for supporting the analysis, modification, testing and implementation of engineering technologies across a variety of mechanical engineering projects. This position requires strong technical knowledge, analytical skills and the ability to apply engineering principles to improve system performance, efficiency and reliability while ensuring compliance with industry standards and project requirements.

•	Prepare technical reports, documentation and analysis relating to engineering modifications, testing outcomes and project implementation.
•	Support engineers in identifying technical issues within engineering systems and recommend practical improvements.
•	Participate in the implementation and commissioning of engineering projects, ensuring compliance with specifications and industry standards.
•	Conduct performance evaluations of engineering systems and recommend adjustments to optimise functionality and operational performance.
•	Collaborate with project teams to integrate new technologies into existing mechanical and operational systems.
•	Ensure all engineering modifications and project implementations comply with workplace health and safety requirements, engineering standards and project objectives.

•	Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in engineering or other comparable and relevant field

•	Demonstrated ability to analyse, modify and improve engineering systems and processes.
•	Experience in testing, validating and implementing engineering technologies and solutions.
•	Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, engineering specifications and project documentation.
•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.

We are looking for an experienced and strategic ICT Manager to lead the planning, development, and day-to-day management of our organisation's information and communication technology systems. This role is central to ensuring our technology infrastructure supports business objectives effectively and securely. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical knowledge, sound leadership capability, and the ability to translate complex ICT requirements into practical solutions. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to drive digital initiatives and maintain a reliable, secure, and efficient ICT environment.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse organisational information needs and specify appropriate technology solutions to meet current and future business requirements
Formulate, implement, and continuously review ICT strategies, policies, and operational plans aligned with broader organisational goals
Direct the evaluation, procurement, and installation of ICT hardware, software, and infrastructure, ensuring value for money and fitness for purpose
Oversee the security and integrity of all ICT systems, including risk assessments, data protection compliance, and incident response planning
Set priorities and allocate resources across system development, maintenance, and daily operations to ensure continuity of service
Lead and manage the ICT team, including recruitment, performance management, professional development, and workload planning
Direct the provision of user training and technical support, ensuring staff are equipped to use systems effectively
Manage vendor and contractor relationships, including negotiating contracts, monitoring service levels, and ensuring delivery against agreed outcomes
Develop and manage ICT budgets, tracking expenditure and identifying opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising performance
Oversee the implementation of new systems and technology projects, managing timelines, risks, and stakeholder communication throughout
Ensure ICT operations comply with relevant legislation, industry standards, and internal governance frameworks
Produce and present regular reports on ICT performance, project progress, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
Proven experience in an ICT management or senior technical leadership role, typically five or more years
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement ICT strategies, policies, and operational frameworks
Strong knowledge of network infrastructure, systems administration, cybersecurity principles, and cloud-based technologies
Experience managing budgets, vendor contracts, and procurement processes within an ICT context
Solid understanding of data privacy legislation and information security standards, including ISO 27001 or equivalent
Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to mentor and develop technical teams
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with a structured approach to decision-making
Effective communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Experience delivering ICT projects using recognised project management methodologies such as PRINCE2 or Agile
Preferred Qualifications
Postgraduate qualification in IT management, business administration, or a related field
Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CISSP, or equivalent
Experience working within regulated industries or government environments
Familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) or customer relationship management (CRM) platforms
Knowledge of COBIT or other IT governance frameworks
Experience leading digital transformation or large-scale systems migration projects
Why Join Us?
Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation that genuinely values technology as a driver of business success
Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including funded certifications and leadership programmes
Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options to support work-life balance
Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation and performance-based incentives
Contribute to meaningful projects that have a real impact on organisational outcomes and service delivery
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
Field Service Technician
Premier Tech Systems and Automation Pty Limited
Full-time
130,000 – $140,000 (inclusive of guaranteed allowances) + super

The company

As part of the well-respected and successful international Premier Tech group, and with an
Australian history dating back to the 1950’s, we are a leader within the bulk handling and
packaging equipment industry in Australia.  We are collaborative and innovative, and we love
what we do.

The role

As part of a national team of field service technicians servicing and commissioning a range of
specialised flexible packaging machinery installed around the country and abroad, you will
travel extensively (approx. 75% of the role) throughout metro and regional VIC, as well as
interstate and the occasional international trip. 

Providing expert advice and service for robotic and conventional palletisers, bagging
machines, wrapping and hooding machines and their corresponding control systems, you
should expect to spend most of your time working on customer sites, with the remaining time
spent working between the West Heidelberg office and home.


JOB DESCRIPTION


Fundamental Duties and responsibilities 	

Perform in-house and on-site equipment installations and start-ups  
•	Install equipment at customers’ locations according to safety standards and established corporate procedures 
•	Perform initial start-ups for installed equipment
•	Test and verify installed equipment at customers’ locations
•	Perform tests and verify the proper functioning of equipment
•	Train customers on the proper operation of the equipment
•	Prepare reports on completed installations
•	Do in-house equipment start-ups before it leaves for customers’ locations

Solve various equipment problems for customers
•	Visit customers in order to diagnose equipment problems
•	Find solutions in collaboration with the engineering team
•	Adjust and repair customers’ equipment and ensure it is operated safely and according to the original specifications
•	Prepare reports following service calls
•	Contribute to product development

Do preventive equipment maintenance at various customers’ locations
•	Evaluate the safety, general state and compliance of various equipment
•	Do preventive maintenance and repair on equipment
•	Ensure proper equipment functioning following maintenance visits
•	Plan following maintenance visits as needed
•	Provide on-site and/or remote technical support to clients
•	Prepare reports on the work performed

Provide over the phone technical support for customers 
•	Diagnose problems and identify possible solutions for customers
•	Help customers find safe solutions to problems
•	Promote preventive maintenance and training services to customers

Other generic tasks as required
•	Preparing drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists
•	Assisting Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists in the design of mechanical equipment and plant
•	Selecting tools and equipment
•	Assembling and installing new and modified mechanical assemblies, components, machine tools and controls, and hydraulic power systems
•	Estimating material costs and quantities, and machine requirements
•	Performing and directing field and laboratory tests
•	Collecting and analysing data, carrying out complex computations and preparing diagrams
•	Organising and supervising inspection and maintenance of machines and plant
•	Ensuring that designs and finished work are within specifications, regulations and contract provisions
•	Prepares detailed drawings and plans of mechanical engineering work in support of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists.
 


Advanced Duties and responsibilities 	

•	Assume responsibility for a certain type of service or equipment for customers
•	Do relatively complex installations at customers’ locations
•	Solve complex equipment problems for customers 
•	Provide over the phone technical support for customers 
•	Master preventive maintenance of equipment and suggest improvements to customers during service calls
•	Meet the demand for technical information from potential customers and promote Premier Tech products to customers 


•	Expert Duties and responsibilities 	

•	Be the go-to person for the team as work is carried out
•	Be an instructor and mentor for new team members
•	Collaborate in the equipment design process with the engineering team 
•	Help develop and implement work procedures and methods 
•	Organize installations or repair work to be done
•	Develop and provide specific technical service expertise to the team 
•	Apply different analysis and problem solving skills to diagnose and repair a variety of equipment  
•	Resolve unusual, major and complex problems on customers’ equipment
•	Do major and non-standard equipment installations at customers’ sites




 
COMPETENCIES PROFILE

Qualifications

At least a trade qualification, associate diploma in engineering or suitable equivalent mechanical/electrical/electronic/control automation qualification.

Technical competencies 	

•	In-depth specific knowledge of Premier Tech packaging machinery including Bottom-Up Filling Technology is highly desirable.
•	Interpreting mechanical and general assembly drawings
•	Interpreting hydraulic circuit drawings
•	Interpreting pneumatic circuit drawings
•	Interpreting electrical schematics
•	Interpreting general installation and industrial buildings layouts
•	Industrial PLC, networks and communication protocols
•	installation, commissioning and maintenance of industrial robots, packaging and powder conveying systems.
•	Installation and optimisation of pneumatically operated equipment
•	Installation, commissioning and troubleshooting of field devices and instrumentation
•	Installation and commissioning of industrial machinery safety systems and guarding.
•	Safe troubleshooting of partially energised systems
•	Troubleshooting PLCs programs, mechanical and electrical installations.
•	Systems and equipment start-up
•	Equipment preventative maintenance
•	Service reports generation
•	Training of machine Operators and Maintenance Crews
•	English communication


Culture

As a well-respected and successful business, we have a range of long term, loyal and
committed team members, creating a solid team environment and providing job security. We
work hard but always find time for a laugh. We care about our team and strive to be an
employer of choice!

What’s in it for you?

•	Competitive salary + travel allowance
•	A professional and friendly work environment
•	A hybrid work arrangement with opportunity to work from home or office (as required) when
•	not travelling
•	Fabulous Employee Assistance Program that includes telehealth appointments and
•	extends to immediate family members
•	On-going training and development.

How to apply

Please apply with a current CV and a separate cover letter outlining why you think
you are the right person for this opportunity.

Please note that only shortlisted applicants will be contacted and we thank you in advance for
your time and interest in working with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

At D'ASCANIO MOTOR REPAIRS, we are looking for a full time (at least 38 hours per week) skilled Motor Mechanic (General) to perform the following duties:
Responsibilities
•	Utilize diagnostic software and electronic scanning tools to identify malfunctions within vehicle systems and verify component performance. 
•	Carry out routine vehicle servicing, including fluid replacements, system lubrication, and calibration adjustments to maintain efficiency and meet emissions standards. 
•	Conduct performance evaluations by running engines and mechanical systems post-repair to confirm reliability and proper operation. 
•	Consult technical documentation and manufacturer guidelines while restoring or substituting damaged components within mechanical assemblies. 
•	Disassemble major vehicle units such as powertrains, gearboxes, and steering systems to inspect internal elements for wear or damage. 
•	Reconstruct and reinstall engine systems and related parts following completion of repairs or part replacements. 
•	Troubleshoot both electrical circuits and mechanical assemblies to determine the root causes of operational failures. 
Requirements
•	Relevant Qualification or 3 years of experience in lieu of the qualification.
•	At least 1 year of experience in the relevant role. 
•	Professional approach.
•	Ability to work under pressure.
•	Organisational and time management skills.
•	Excellent attention to detail.
•	Confident manner.
•	Positive approach to change.
